note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', and user avatar; user-specific counts and the current user's name are subtracted

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; the project name header is subtracted as it is user-defined
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project namespace and name, which are fixed for the current context and not editable by arbitrary users without project admin rights
Merge request state filter tabs -- renders: 'Opened', 'Merged', 'Closed', 'All'
Content area controls -- renders: 'New merge request', 'Bulk update', 'Sort', 'Filter', and other fixed action buttons; the merge request list and search input are subtracted
